coverage_issues: qwen model failed on second pass PKGBUILD review due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: When a model's initial PKGBUILD audit succeeds but a later file review fails due to a transient API error, the tool should consider falling back to the initial audit result rather than marking the entire package inconclusive
